hook: A transformer decoder matches slower integer-programming decoders and runs in 6.59 microseconds on an FPGA

readout.label: Decoding latency, distance-8 block on FPGA

summary: PRISM is a transformer decoder that uses the known locations of erasures in photonic fusion-based quantum computing. On surface, color and quantum LDPC codes up to distance 24 it matches the logical error rates of integer-programming decoders while running faster. An FPGA implementation decodes a distance-8 block in 6.59 microseconds. Benchmarks are on simulated noise, not on real photonic hardware.
title: Machine-learning decoders for fusion-based quantum computing in real time
